entities.name: Henry I the Bearded
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henry the Bearded was a Polish duke from the Piast dynasty. He was Duke of Silesia at Wrocław from 1201, Duke of Kraków and High Duke of all Poland – internally divided – from 1232 until his death.
